title: VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code on the Game Gear (S0: the skeleton)
description: The Game Gear port of VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code (docs/projects/sega-vrun-ports-plan.md, S1: tick-identical to Eternal Degrade like the Game Boy version, the Game Boy Color's colours). Today the S0 skeleton: a hello ROM (text, a frame counter, a cursor that Left / Right move) that proves the toolchain and BrokenDev's build / verify / compat. Built with SDCC 4.6.0 + devkitSMS (toolchains.json) in its live workspace PROJECTS/VRUN_VOC_GG_dev (its own git, local only).

toolchain: SDCC 4.6.0 and devkitSMS 533ae57, pinned in toolchains.json (SMSlib and crt0 rebuilt from devkitSMS's sources by build.ps1)

steps.name: build
steps.note: build.ps1: SMSlib_GG and crt0 rebuilt once (build/smslib-gg), sdcc -mz80 -DTARGET_GG, makesms; checks 'TMR SEGA' and the Game Gear region code (7).

run.note: The skeleton: Left / Right move the cursor. Lite: the .gg opens in BrokenNes Lite's Game Gear (UAT/entrypoints/lite-sega.ps1 -Roms <folder with gg\vrun_voc_gg.gg>).

memory.what: the vblank loop runs every frame
Right reached the pad and moved the cursor to the window's right edge (20 columns)

scenarios.why: the hello ROM on the Game Gear: it runs, draws and reads the pad

compat.what: The hello ROM on every Game Gear emulator BrokenDev has, from power-on and the same pad script, its state read by the build's symbols every frame.

scenarios.what: power-on, the text, Right held 30 frames

checks.what: the main loop runs (frame_count keeps changing)
Right moved the cursor to the right edge

comparison.what: The cross-console comparison (S0): the port against its original, VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code on the Game Boy (project vrun-voc). S1 is tick-identical: the strictest tolerances. Filled in by S1 when the game exists; the skeleton maps nothing yet.

knownIssues: S0 skeleton only: the game is S1.
No hardware test on the user's Genesis flash cart yet (Game Gear through its backwards compatibility).
